scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: role, aria-orientation, data-orientation, reflection, recipe class, no native elements; the resolver
SSR markup, render and className function, state parity with the web component

limitations: Geometry review (manual, 2026-11-02): thickness max(1px, B) checked in apps/studio/geometry-check.html at every size × B 0 and 1 (horizontal height, vertical width, full span); growth: a horizontal separator spans any container width and a vertical one any row height, it has no text; RTL: nothing to mirror; focus: not focusable; light and dark screenshots of the Display family at the theme unit and the size ladder (3, 4, 6) on the Components page.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Separator with ui-separator at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
